svg.title: Exploded sieve-tray distillation column
svg.desc: Isometric exploded view of a distillation column. The shell is cut open to show the sump liquid; three sieve trays with perforated decks, outlet weirs and downcomers are lifted out above it; the top head carries the vapour line to an overhead condenser and reflux drum, and a thermosyphon reboiler returns vapour to the base. Vapour rises through the trays while liquid falls down the downcomers. Closed, the trays sit inside a full flanged shell under the head.
